how: The filing window is pending the confirmed last active-duty day. Give Claude the date IPAC confirms to record on the service-end milestone. VA or your VSO must confirm the endpoints before filing. The filing target may move back for a weekend; the actual window endpoints do not.

cite.ref: VA Benefits and Services Participant Guide v6.1
cite.quote: You'll need to have a known Separation Date and do the following:

cite.ref: VA Benefits and Services Participant Guide v6.1
cite.quote: Submit your BDD claims between 180 and 90 days before the very last day of service on active duty. For BDD purposes, this separation date is not when you start Transitional or Terminal Leave or Permissive Temporary Duty for seeking a home.

cite.quote: Be available 45 days after submitting your BDD claim to attend the required medical exam(s)

items.brief: Filing starts the 45-day period when you must be available for VA exams. Confirm your separation date and filing window with your VSO so travel does not conflict with that requirement.

items.title: VA exams (you must be available 45 days after filing)
items.why: A planning target. Until you mark the BDD filing done, this window is projected from the filing target; once it is done, it counts from the day you filed. VA schedules the exams after you file, and you must be available for 45 days from the filing date. Where the exams are, and whether exam days count as duty time, are questions for VA and IPAC.

cite.ref: VA Benefits and Services Participant Guide v6.1
cite.quote: Be available 45 days after submitting your BDD claim to attend the required medical exam(s)

items.verify: VSO: the day the claim was filed and the exam dates VA gives you. VA and IPAC: exam location, and duty status for exam days.
items.label: Keep time free for VA exams
items.brief: You must be available for VA exams after filing. Record your actual filing date and confirm the scheduled exams so you do not plan around the board's projected window.

items.title: Confirm late additions with VA before BDD closes
items.why: The copied guide establishes BDD filing between 180 and 90 days before the final active-duty day. It does not establish the procedure for adding conditions to an existing BDD claim. Confirm that procedure with VA before the window closes.
how: Day 90 before the last active-duty day is a planning target for confirming additions with VA or your accredited VSO. The additions procedure and actual deadline remain pending VA confirmation.

Give Claude any deadline VA confirms to record as a date rule on this task or a separate actionable task. Record the confirming office and its confirmation in notes. Label that date a confirmed event and preserve the day-90 planning target separately. Use basis rule only if a quoted source sets the deadline.

items.label: Confirm how to add claim conditions

items.why: If the SHA is used instead of a separate SHPE, return completed results to DoD at least 30 days before your confirmed last active-duty day. items.label: Confirm your completed assessment was returned

how: Current Class II criteria and application deadline remain pending VA dental clinic confirmation.

Record and confirm that receipt date; the resignation planning target does not promise approval by EAS.
how: Give RAM-1 the requested separation date and ask about the applicable scroll.
Confirm and record HQMC receipt of the Reserve appointment request with RAM-1.

Give Claude the actual HQMC receipt date that RAM-1 confirms to record on the separate receipt item. The date RAM-1 replies is not the receipt date.

Officers without adverse information in any Department of the Navy systems of record are then placed on the non-adverse scroll and routed from HQMC, RA Division via the DC M&RA to the SecDef. The non-adverse transitional scrolling process may require a longer lead time than the minimum length of time required by the resignation process (four months per paragraph 5003 of this Manual).

items.title: Leave plan: decide the balance you want at the end, then plan the blocks
items.why: The desired final balance is your planning choice. Sellback depends on honorable separation, prior sales and any chapter 2, 2.b exception to the 60-day career cap. A projected negative balance does not authorize advance leave. Confirm the urgent, personal or emergency purpose, limits and CO approval. A negative balance at discharge becomes excess leave subject to collection from pay.
how: The payable amount and any cap exception remain pending IPAC and disbursing confirmation.

cite.quote: Separation payments for unused accrued leave are limited to 60 days during a military career per reference (q).

A Marine who is separated or released from active duty under honorable conditions may elect to receive payment for a portion of the unused leave ... Payment of leave for Reserve Component (RC) Marines or Retired Marines activated in support of a contingency operation or RC Marines on Active Duty Operational Support (ADOS) orders not exceeding 365 days are exempt from the 60-day leave payment limitation per reference (q).

Advance leave is a means whereby Marines with limited or no accrued leave may be granted leave to resolve urgent, personal, or emergency situations. ... advance leave resulting in a negative leave balance on date of discharge, or release from active duty, becomes excess leave and is subject to checkage of pay and allowances.
advance leave shall be limited to the lesser of: (1) 45 days or (2) The amount of leave that shall be earned during the remaining period of active duty
Accrued leave shall be expended prior to the authorization of advance leave.

Do not approve leave in excess of the number of days which the Marine can accrue before the end of current contract (ECC). Leave taken beyond that which can be earned is excess leave and results in nonentitlement to pay and allowances.

items.verify: IPAC, disbursing and CO: confirm qualifying sellback, prior sales, any cap exception and advance-leave purpose, limits and approval.
items.label: Plan your remaining leave
items.brief: Your final leave balance affects sellback and possible debt. Confirm approved leave and payable days with IPAC and disbursing; a negative balance at discharge can be collected from your pay.

items.title: Confirm the previously requested terminal leave and PTAD dates
items.why: Supply desired leave/PTAD dates, duration and planned detachment date with the advance separation request. The manual says to allow 120 days plus desired leave/PTAD lead time. The 90-day board date is a final planning confirmation target. Confirm STR acceptance and all separation requirements before the first applicable absence.

cite.quote: Officers and enlisted Marines with an approved retirement date are eligible for transition PTAD.

If leave is desired in conjunction with a request for separation, the appropriate separation request should be submitted at least 120 days plus the amount of desired leave (to include PTAD) before the effective date of separation. When the request is submitted via unit diary, enter the planned detachment date (PDD) as part of the unit diary request for separation.
Marines anticipating terminal leave in conjunction with separation must inform the CMC (MMSR) of the date and duration of the desired leave upon submission of the request.

Terminal leave is not granted until all separation requirements--both administrative and medical--are complete. Terminal leave runs continuously from the first day of leave until the date of EAS or transfer to the Retired List/FMCR.

Every Marine must submit their Service Treatment Record (STR) to their Marine Corps activity effecting separations (IPAC/Administration RUC) prior to execution of transitional PTAD, terminal leave, transfer to the IRR, separation or retirement. A complete STR includes: Service provided medical and dental documentation, civilian provided medical and dental documentation, Armed Forces Health Longitudinal Technology Application (AHLTA) web print (AWP) information, and a completed DD Form 2963.

items.verify: IPAC and MMSR-2: confirm the earlier separation request and leave/PTAD lead time. IPAC, medical records and CO: confirm STR acceptance, all separation gates and approved absence dates.

items.brief: Your requested leave and PTAD must fit the earlier separation request and completed separation requirements. Confirm approved dates and records acceptance so a final planning check is not mistaken for the initial request.
